items.summary: CTO recommendation: approve containment-only execution. No new proposals, change requests, requeues, telemetry, dependencies, spend, monetization expansion, or production changes are technically eligible this cycle. Continue only existing measurement, reconciliation, failed-run repair-or-close review, and bounded legal/security evidence work. Preserve all unsupported revenue, ROI, margin, causal-lift, budget, and operational fields as unknown.

Queue disposition: no new queue entry. Existing capacity is occupied by scheduled measurement, reconciliation, failure containment, and evidence work; the authoritative actionability candidate list is empty. Failed work must remain contained until canonical lineage, deduplication, ownership, root cause, isolated validation, rollback, and explicit requeue-or-close evidence are documented.

Maintain the gated product's private launch gate. Continue bounded read-only rights, data-flow, retention, consent, vendor, accuracy, attribution, and security evidence capture. Keep external permission outreach unsent pending owner and human-counsel authorization; do not expose publicly, expand alerts, deploy, change credentials or configuration, or add dependencies.

Measurement disposition: continue scheduled observations using existing source-dated impressions, clicks, sessions, conversions, site-attributed commission, and available AI-cost records only. Do not add instrumentation or request duplicate telemetry. Aggregate commission remains explicitly unassigned, and financial outcomes remain unknown.
